timeline.alt: A timeline from 2026 to 2036 with eight guesses: Elon Musk 2026, Dario Amodei 2027, Sam Altman 2028, Shane Legg 2028, Ray Kurzweil 2029, Demis Hassabis 2030, Dwarkesh Patel 2032, Andrej Karpathy 2035.

levers.title: Six levers that shape an AI's result in a given task
levers.alt: Three agents inside a harness, inside an environment: Claude, Gemini, and GPT, each with a reasoning effort. The harness has tools and context management. The environment holds the harness and the metric. The metric is a way to score and measure a result.

arcmodels.title: Leading models on ARC-AGI-3 with the standard harness

arc.title: GPT-6 Astra on ARC-AGI-3, by harness and reasoning effort
arc.alt: ARC-AGI-3 scores of GPT-6 Astra in two harnesses at six reasoning effort levels. Standard harness scores range from 17.5% to 62.7%; OpenAI harness scores range from 96.7% to 99.9%.

venn.title: Fable and Astra solve different Terminal-Bench 4.1 tasks
venn.alt: Venn diagram of 66 Terminal-Bench 4.1 tasks: 36 solved by both models, 9 by Claude Fable 5.2 only, 4 by GPT-6.2 Astra only

comms.title: How agents communicate can help by 81% or hurt by 70%
comms.alt: Multi-agent performance change versus a single agent: Finance-Agent +57% to +80.8%, WorkBench -11% to +6%, SWE-bench Verified -15% to -2%, PlanCraft -70% to -39%.

env.title: Changing the desktop interface doubles success on OSWorld
env.alt: OSWorld success rates moving from raw screenshots to structured interfaces: GPT-4V 5.26% to 12.17%, GPT-4o 5.03% to 11.36%, Claude 3 Opus 2.42% to 6.72%.

metric.title: Extra attempts only scale when a metric can verify them
metric.alt: SWE-bench Lite with unit tests rises from 15.9% at 1 attempt to 56% at 250 attempts, beating the 43% single-try record. On MATH from 100 to 10,000 samples, the oracle ceiling rises from 82.9% to 98.44%, while majority voting and reward models stall from 40.50% to 41.41%.

nvidia.title: Nvidia's harness takes Claude Opus 5 from 30% to 100% on ARC-AGI-3
nvidia.alt: Without the harness the agent goes into a dead end, comes back and tries it again, and does not solve the task.

price.title: How much cheaper each technology gets per year
price.alt: The average price decline per year of AI and of four older technologies, on a log scale.

shift.title: Both the one-shot and bespoke buckets grow together
shift.alt: Schematic showing the three problem buckets shifting as models improve and intelligence gets cheaper: both the one-shot bucket and the bespoke-solution bucket grow while the unsolvable bucket shrinks.

loop.alt: A loop: a goal and a metric, a swarm of agents, a measurement, and insights that go into the next round.

skynet.title: From your goal and budget to a verifiable solution
skynet.alt: Skynet in the center of a ring of the six levers: the model, the reasoning effort, attempts and agents, the harness, the environment, and the metric. The goal and a budget go in, and a verifiable solution comes out.
